q1_issues.issue: The ellipsis pro-form "did" is reified as a literal `do` event, asserting an unspecified doing rather than reconstructing the elided verb phrase.

The coordinated objects of "included" are collapsed into one event carrying three `Theme` atoms, whereas coordinated NPs are distributive by default (one event per conjunct) and the one-event-many-role form is reserved for reciprocal/aggregate predicates.
"and then some" is dropped with no atom of any kind, so the emphatic scalar content of the main clause is lost.

q2_gaps: VP-ellipsis ("She did") whose antecedent verb phrase is outside the sentence being translated — the instruction set says to reconstruct the verb but gives no route when the text supplies no antecedent
the emphatic idiom "and then some" (scalar 'and more than that')
privative / temporal adjectives on a noun ("former winners") — no rule; the parse approximates with `Past`-wrapped typing atoms
"as well as" as a coordinator — the additive focus-particle list has bare "as well", not the coordinating phrase, so no `Also` tag is clearly licensed or required here
notes: The "144-player field" NP is handled well (collective noun + `GroupOf` + `Cardinality`), and the pronoun "She" correctly takes a `person`-classed witness.
